title: Retaking a course
text: Students may retake a course they failed. Retake credits are charged at 1.5 times the normal rate. Final-year students must register retakes before week 2.

title: Thesis registration
text: Students may register a thesis when they have at least 120 accumulated credits and a GPA of at least 2.0.

title: Late thesis registration
text: Late thesis registration requires approval from the Faculty and the supervisor.

title: Credit load
text: A regular semester load is between 14 and 30 credits. More than 30 credits requires approval.

title: Exam absence
text: Students absent from a final exam for medical reasons must submit evidence to the Training Office within 3 working days.
